caption: Ponte delle Torri, Spoleto
composition: Tall medieval aqueduct-bridge spanning a deep Umbrian gorge · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera faces the Ponte delle Torri, its two tiers of tall arches spanning the wooded gorge from left to right. The arches frame the forested slopes and the distant mountains, and the medieval stonework stands out against the bright blue sky. The 13:22 midday sun lights the whole structure.
